entries.en: [The scientist is resting peacefully.]
Mnngh.
Unnngh.
Uh. Mnn.
[The scientist is resting peacefully.]
Unnngh.
Uh. Mnn.
Mnngh.
This system is online and ready to provide emergency services.
Accessing logs. They were in the midst of an experiment when the shutdown began.
When you were taken offline.
Without my program to administrate containment procedures, a quarantine breach occurred.
I'm afraid treatment is not possible. An unknown toxin is present within the tissues of each patient.
I administrate the systems of all of the various Peak 15 facilities.
Our medic-- He's not with us any more. Mira's running the automatic systems for us.
I form the core logic for Rift Station's automatic treatment system.
Certainly, Commander. One moment, please.
Very well, Commander. Logging you out.
What's wrong with these people?
What treatments have been attempted?
What are you doing over here?
Think you could run that equipment for us?
We don't need anything right now.
Sick scientists
A cure
Mira?
We need first aid.
Log out.
They were exposed to a novel form of toxin. An antidote has been successfully administered. Prognosis is good.
Of course. Here.
I need to administer this. Thanks again.
Yes?
They're suffering from a toxin. There was an accident.
I-- I have a non-disclosure agreement. I shouldn't discuss it with anyone outside of the company.
I'd like to think the company finds our lives more valuable than their secrets.
You know Mira? The VI for Peak 15? She handles the safety protocols for our experiments here.
That was you? I'm grateful. Until she came online, the automatic equipment wouldn't work.
All progress requires-- Look. Is this really the time for an ethics debate?
We lost the connection to Mira in the middle of an experiment, and the quarantine failed.
These three were exposed to a toxin. Something we were working on.
No! Wait.
It's a bio-weapon. Based on an exotic life-form discovered on the frontier. They wanted something that could kill the creature.
But there was no profit in something that kills one species on the frontier. We kept working on it. Adapted it to affect more species.
Damn salarians. Just love to play with bugs.
Things like that never get out of control.
Thoros-B is highly infectious, but can't pass from one person to another. Like a biowar attack without a pandemic spread.
Militaries, governments -- they'll get this kind of weapon one way or another. We're trying to limit the damage. I know you can't see that.
I didn't expect you'd understand.
Our first priority was getting it working. We were close to synthesizing an antidote when Mira went down.
Our notes and equipment are locked in the quarantine labs. Captain Ventralis doesn't want to risk more contamination.
I suppose. It's not allowed, but there's nothing back there. If you can save these men, I'll do that for you.
No! The toxin has a brief period of viability. After that it breaks down into simple protein chains. But he won't listen to me.
No, of course. You don't look like a biochemist. No offense.
I can't ask you to do this officially. But if you can do anything, I'd appreciate it.
I'm just trying to avoid an incident.
The quarantine labs are near the science team's quarters.
Once you're in there, look for our notes. It should just be a matter of following our processes.
You're not supposed to go back there. But I guess there's nothing to hurt.
Here's my pass. Just don't tell the guards.
I have a pass, but there's nothing back there. Just snow. Well, snow and maintenance access.
I have your word on that?
No, it doesn't. Take it.
Look. You see that my friends are sick.
You bring me the cure, I'll give you my pass. Strictly under the table.
I'm "a" doctor, but not "the" doctor. My specialty is microbiology. Not first aid.
We had a medic. Dr. Saleh. He's de-- We lost him. The automatics can handle basic treatment. Mira runs them.
Better than Ventralis' guards. They've been on alert since the first attack.
I've been administering stims at their request, but every species needs to sleep. They're getting twitchy. Irrational.
I hope you can do something.
Mmmhmm. Yes.
What? What do you want?
No. You did nothing wrong. I'm just distracted.
They seem to be coming along well.
It will take time for them to recover. They're through the worst.
Of course. Be careful.
Is that the cure? You did it?
You were attacked? I-- I don't know anything about that! I hate conflict. I've never even fired anyone. I have my receptionist do it.
Look. The guards. They've been more on edge since you got here. I think they were expecting you.
There are more labs in the back. The guards won't even let me back there. Just people with "clearance."
The maintenance area? Yes, take my pass. But there's just snow back there.
I don't want to get involved in this. I'm just trying to save my friends.
Let me see that phial. An extension on Phelps' work? I thought he was on the right track.
I can't thank you enough. God. What a cliché. You saved their lives, you know that?
You didn't get these from me. Ventralis wanted them saved for his people.
Thanks for the warning. Here's the cure.
Somebody in here needs a punch in the throat.
Could you spare a few medical packs? They're worth their weight in gold up here.
And I almost lost mine. "Thanks" is all I get? We need to be at peak to fight those aliens. Give us some medi-gel.
That's what I'm here for. Forget about it.
What happened to these people?
But you're going to, because I might be able to help.
We reactivated her on our way through Central Station.
You should consider doing safer experiments.
Makes sense. She seems to regulate everything else up here.
I understand your caution, but I need details. What you say won't go beyond these walls.
I need full cooperation if I'm going to help. Do you want these people to live? If not, I'll walk out of here.
You made this, but can't cure it? Don't you people take notes?
There's a reason the Citadel Conventions forbid bioweapons, Doctor.
But you don't have an antidote?
I want access to the maintenance area.
Is he right to keep people out?
I'll talk to Ventralis for you, but I don't have the training for that.
I'll talk to him. Maybe I can convince him to let me try.
Suit yourself.
What will it take to get the cure for these people?
I need to get into the maintenance areas.
Things are going to hit the fan in this place. Slip me the card and I'll keep your team safe.
I'm going to get back there one way or another. This place doesn't need more holes blown in it.
What would change your mind about that?
Are you the doctor here?
How is the science team holding up?
Talk to you later.
Were they attacked by the aliens?
I didn't mean to bother you.
They don't look much better.
Good news. I'll see you around.
I was ambushed in the lab you sent me to. If you set me up...
I think so. It was hard to concentrate while dodging gunfire.
What about the maintenance area? Do you have access to that?
What's wrong with them?
Sorry.
The patients
Goodbye.
You set me up.
I have the antitoxin.
Getting into maintenance.
Thanks for the warning.
I'm going to hurt someone.
Got any medi-gel?
I need more.
That's my duty.
Are these people sick?
How can I help these people?
Get me into maintenance.
Your job
Your team
Goodbye.
But you want to.
Your call.
I fixed her.
Sounds dangerous to me.
I know her.
I need more to help.
Tell me everything.
You don't have a cure?
You don't have a cure?
Damn right I can't.
Get me into maintenance.
Is it dangerous in there?
I'm no scientist.
I'll see what I can do.
I can protect you.
I could blast in.
Could we negotiate?
It doesn't matter how "safe" you make it. Biological weapons are illegal.
Do you imagine that distinction makes this ethical?
Yes. I'm sorry. I haven't had much sleep lately.
Alestia? That's unbe--!
I-- I don't know much about her. She arrived a month ago. One of the shareholders pulled strings to get her here.
Let me guess. Saren, the Spectre?
Let me guess. Saren, the Spectre?
Let me guess. Saren, the Spectre?
Let me guess. Saren, the Spectre?
Let me guess. Saren, the Spectre?
Yes. I think that was the name. I don't pay attention to the other research teams.
Is there a cure, Doctor? A treatment?
I've had a long day. Don't piss me off.
That asari scientist -- the one in the mess hall -- she just tried to kill us.
An asari attacked me.
Worry about that later.
I don't like your tone.
We can't have any shooting in here.
Just don't tell the guards. They're twitchy enough.
Please, take it outside!
This is a hospital, for God's sake!
I could help.
Only as a means to an end, Doctor. I have a mission to complete.
If you made it, you must have an idea how to cure it.
Congratulations. You made an illegal bioweapon. You think to make a cure for it?
I have reason to believe something's hidden back there. I need your help, Doctor.
Doctor, even an elcor could tell this crew is hiding something. Why don't you want me back there?
Happy to help.
It was on my way.
You made it?
"Good job."
I can be pretty persuasive.
There's more than snow.
Are you hiding something?
I can be pretty persuasive.
Speaking of that back area...
Just take the cure.
Hang on.
Uhn...
I know you'd have a cure by now.
